title: Business Development Executive
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Manchester - office based

Full time

Permanent

Looking for a fresh challenge in industrial automation?

At Routeco, our vision is to be Europe's leading industrial automation and controls specialist. We combine seamless customer experience with unmatched technical expertise to create lasting partnerships that make a real difference to businesses and people. This is Routeco Know-How.

As part of the Sonepar Group-the largest B2 B electrical distributor globally-we offer the stability and scale of a global organisation, while staying firmly rooted in the UK market.

We're committed to shaping a forward-thinking future, valuing professionalism, agility and teamwork every step of the way, with customers at the centre of every decision.

If you want to grow with a company that cares about its people and the world around us, discover what makes Routeco stand out and see where your career could take you.

Supporting customers. Solving problems. Growing together.

We put the customer at the heart of everything we do. As part of our Internal Sales team, you'll play a key role in delivering fast, friendly and knowledgeable support - helping customers with enquiries, quotes and orders across phone, email and digital channels.

You'll work closely with External Sales and Technical colleagues, making sure every customer receives a smooth and professional experience.
- Be part of a friendly, supportive team that values collaboration and celebrates shared success.
- Join a business built on Professionalism, Agility, Collaboration and Excellence, where people take pride in doing the right thing.
- Make an impact every day by helping customers keep their operations running smoothly.

What you'll be doing
- Promoting and selling Routeco products and services, using commercial awareness and negotiation skills to achieve sales targets and support GP growth.
- Providing excellent customer service across phone, email and face-to-face interactions, responding to enquiries accurately and resolving issues promptly.
- Building strong, long-term customer relationships by proactively identifying opportunities, understanding customer needs and encouraging repeat business.
- Developing product knowledge to advise customers on suitable solutions, including franchise and non-franchise products, pricing, availability and delivery timelines.
- Working closely with internal and external sales teams to follow up quotations, convert opportunities and support a smooth customer journey.

What do you need to bring to Routeco?
- A strong customer-focused approach, with the confidence to support customers, manage enquiries and build trusted relationships.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and inspire commitment from colleagues.
- A proactive, results-driven mindset with strong attention to detail, persistence and a methodical way of working.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and data entry systems, with the ability to handle customer and order information accurately.
- GCSEs or equivalent in Maths and English are required; an ONC-level qualification or previous experience in electrical engineering or electrical distribution would be beneficial.

What Routeco can offer you
- Generous Time Off: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with length of service up to 30 days with the option to flex up/down 5 days.
- Long Service Rewards: Celebrate your milestones with special gifts and up to 5 extra holiday days in your anniversary year.
- Wellness Benefits:Access a health and wellbeing cashback scheme
- Financial Security: life assurance coverage at 2x your salary.
- Free Shares: you will be eligible to receive free shares after completing 3 years of service.
- Pension Plan: Join our Group personal pension plan with a 5% employer contribution.
- Continuous Learning:1 hour of protected development every week to enhance your skills
- Family-Friendly Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
- Recognition: Discretionary 'on the spot' and value-based awards for outstanding performance.
- Volunteer Time Off & Workplace giving: Get paid time off for participating in our volunteering programs and contribute to meaningful causes.
- Exclusive Discounts:Access the Associate Discounts Portal for savings.
- Referral Bonuses: Earn financial reward for referring talented individuals.
- Cycle Scheme:Access to salary sacrifice Cycle Scheme.
- Wellbeing Support and Employee Assistance:Access a 24/7 support program through Unum, and Mental Health First Aiders.
- Fitness Benefits: Enjoy gym membership discounts.

Our promise

At Routeco, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you're interested but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply-you might still be a great match. Please inform us of any needed adjustments to the recruitment process when applying.
- We use blind CVs.
- We're GEISS accredited.
- We're a registered Member of Inclusive Employers.
- We have internal focus groups on Mental Health, Menopause, D&I and more.
- We're proud to publish our diversity aims and figures so everyone can see our great work!

Are you ready to make a difference?

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Do you have a natural ability to make people feel comfortable and genuinely listened to?
If you enjoy talking to people, building relationships and making a real difference every day, this Sales Advisor role could be the perfect fit.
We're recruiting for a fast-growing and ambitious business in Altrincham Town Centre looking to expand their friendly team with an Internal Sales Advisor. This is a genuinely rewarding sales based role where you'll finish each day knowing you've helped someone access support that could make a real difference to their life while also having the chance to earn up to 4,000 pa in bonuses. This is a role that offers superb career opportunities
What will you be doing as a Sales Advisor?
This is much more than a typical sales or customer service role. You'll be supporting customers who have already enquired about claiming a government benefit, helping them take the first step towards accessing the financial support they may be entitled to. Duties will include:
- Making outbound calls to customers who have enquired about the services the company provides (no cold calling - these are all warm leads!)
- Speaking with customers over the phone throughout the day, handling queries and following up warm leads
- Building trust and rapport with older customers, making them feel comfortable, supported and understood
- Clearly explaining the service and answering questions with patience and empathy
- Handling objections gently but confidently, guiding customers through the next steps
- Managing your own pipeline of enquiries using the CRM system
- Booking suitable customers into appointments with the Claims Processing team

We would LOVE to hear from you if you have the following skills and experience:
Whether you've worked as a Telesales Executive, Appointment Setter, Customer Service Advisor, Customer Experience Advisor, Contact Centre Advisor, Call Centre Advisor, or in another telephone-based customer service role, we'd love to hear from you.
You'll have:
- A confident, engaging and friendly telephone manner
- The ability to make outbound calls on a daily basis
- Experience in pensions, insurance, claims, or other financial services based industries would be interesting but is not essential
- A kind, compassionate and patient approach and able to handle any objections empathetically and clearly
- The ability to quickly rapport and gain people's trust to guide them to making an appointment
- Clear, easy-to-understand communication skills
- Confidence using a CRM system and managing your own workload
- A positive attitude

What will you get in return for your work as a Sales Advisor?
- 26,000 - 30,000 salary
- The chance to earn 4,000 pa bonus
- Optional overtime paid at time and a half
- Full training and ongoing coaching
- Excellent career progression within a rapidly growing business - the company actively develops people based on their strengths and interests and is happy to create opportunities as the business grows
- Opportunity to progress into a Claims Processor role after your initial training
- Planned private medical cover as the business grows
- Join a supportive team that genuinely celebrates success and helps each other develop

If you're an engaging, people-focused professional looking for your next Internal Sales or Sales Advisor opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your CV today - we can't wait to speak with you!

Apply now by sending your CV. We aim to respond to all successful applications within 2 days. If you haven't been contacted within 2 days your application has been unsuccessful. Please check our website and apply directly for any other suitable positions you see. We apologise that we are unable to contact everyone in person and thank you for your interest. Jobwise Ltd is an employment agency and the details sent in your application may be stored on our secure database.

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Title: New Business Account Executive

Industry: Insurance

Class of Business: Professional Indemnity - Construction Property (Contractors, Surveyors, Architects, Engineers)

Overview:

As a New Business Account Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
Contact Centre Sales & Service Manager
Location: Worsley, Manchester
Salary: 40,000- 50,000 depending on experience
Bonus: Up to 25% performance-related
Hours: Full-time, permanent Office-based
An exciting opportunity to make your mark
We're working with an established and growing consumer-focused business that is entering an exciting period of growth, development and transformation.
As part of this next chapter, they are looking to appoint an experienced Contact Centre Sales & Service Manager to take ownership of their customer contact operation and play a key role in shaping its future.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious contact centre leader who enjoys being hands-on, commercially focused and close to the operation. You'll have the opportunity to develop people, improve performance, introduce new ways of working and make a tangible impact on both customer experience and revenue.
The Role
Leading a team of approximately 14 Contact Centre Advisors, supported by Senior Agents, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day performance of the contact centre across sales and customer service.
You'll be responsible for driving performance across conversion, revenue, retention and cost per sale, while maintaining high standards across service levels, customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution and complaints.
Key responsibilities will include:
Leading, motivating and developing a high-performing contact centre team.
Taking ownership of sales and service performance against agreed KPIs.
Driving outbound sales activity through effective dialler strategy, campaign management and contact optimisation.
Managing inbound performance, call routing and real-time service levels.
Using data, MI and performance dashboards to identify opportunities and drive improvement.
Coaching individuals and teams through call listening, feedback and structured development.
Developing and embedding effective quality assurance and coaching frameworks.
Using call analytics and emerging AI technology to identify trends and improve performance.
Supporting recruitment, onboarding, training and ongoing development.
Managing performance, attendance, engagement and retention.
Taking ownership of customer escalations and complaints where required.
Working closely with other departments to improve the end-to-end customer journey.
Ensuring the operation remains compliant with relevant regulatory requirements, including GDPR and PECR.
Presenting performance insights and improvement plans to senior stakeholders.
About You
We're looking for an experienced Contact Centre Manager / Sales & Service Manager who can combine strong people leadership with a genuine commercial focus.
You'll ideally have:
Proven experience managing a contact centre or high-volume customer operation.
A strong track record across both sales and customer service.
Experience delivering against commercial KPIs such as conversion, revenue, retention and cost per sale.
Strong knowledge of outbound dialler strategy and contact centre technology.
Experience using CRM, telephony and performance data to drive decisions.
A strong coaching mindset and experience developing frontline teams and team leaders.
Experience implementing or managing quality assurance frameworks.
A good understanding of GDPR, PECR and consent requirements.
The confidence to be visible, hands-on and actively involved in the day-to-day operation.
A passion for continuous improvement and finding smarter ways of working.
Experience with AI/speech analytics, HubSpot or similar CRM platforms, and multi-channel customer contact would be advantageous.
Why this opportunity?
This is more than simply taking over an established contact centre. The business is entering an exciting new phase, and this role offers the opportunity to genuinely influence how the operation develops.
You'll have the scope to shape processes, develop your people, improve commercial performance and introduce new ideas and technology - while working closely with senior leadership and playing a key role in the wider growth strategy.
If you're an ambitious contact centre leader looking for a role where your ideas, leadership and results will make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply now for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.
